name: Western Movie
author: DamianosKabanos
description: Let go of the dash orb at 34%, just before the cube portal to fall out of the level. Time a click at 57.7% to re-enter the level. Time a small click on the green orb at 60% to go between two sawblades and skip the cube portal. Navigate through the gameplay, then tap the dash orb at 63% and avoid two invisible hitboxes from 69% to 71%. Free to the end from there.
